## MMVH Engine — deterministic booking tools
Called by the AI agent (Front Desk) via **Workflow Tool** nodes with `action` = check | book | cancel | reschedule.

* Loads **Config at runtime** from the Sheet on every call (E4)
* All business rules + live Google Calendar conflicts are checked in code — the LLM can never invent a booking
* Every Google call has its own success/failure branch: rollback, revert, or NEEDS_ATTENTION
### Book: create event → save row → (row fails ⇒ delete event; delete fails ⇒ NEEDS_ATTENTION)
### Reschedule (E2): move event → update same row → (row fails ⇒ move event back)
### Cancel: delete event → mark row CANCELED (confirm only after deletion succeeds)
